links.outcome: Prospective performance of ECG triage AI on live clinical data versus final clinical diagnosis triage classes
links.effect: Mean concordance statistic 0.96 (95% CI 0.95-0.97); zero ECGs needing policy change or cardiology referral were missed; 2.6% predicted acute did not require follow-up.
links.quote: Performance was good with a mean concordance statistic of 0.96 (95% confidence interval 0.95-0.97) when comparing DELTAnet with the clinical triage classes.

screen.reason: Prospective cohort study evaluating the implementation of a deep learning model (DELTAnet) for ECG triage in routine clinical care.
